instruction: Use the already opened Bonsai/Blender IFC authoring environment and its CLI/API tools to update /home/user/Desktop/init.ifc and save the finished model as /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc. Before starting the work, Bonsai is installed as a Blender extension, so start `/opt/blender/blender` and use the Bonsai tools from that environment. Do not create, rewrite, copy, patch, or post-process the IFC outside that software environment. The model is a simple two-storey townhouse concept with a flat roof slab and compact residential rooms on both levels. The architect needs the model normalised for residential design review: the two levels should read as ground and first floor, the living, kitchen, bedroom, and bathroom should carry residential room references, and the envelope should use one coherent townhouse wall construction. Keep the existing storey relationship, spaces, slabs, openings, door, and windows. Use a brick-and-gypsum wall build-up, a concrete slab type across the floors, and record the update with revision code BONSAI-CLI-04 on the residential spaces and envelope elements.
